_comment: What the client has learned about each deployment. Written automatically.
Size limits were cleared when the deployment/quota changed — they were
inferred against a throttled deployment and do not describe a new one.
'temperature' stays: that is a property of the model, not the deployment.

notes.temperature: Unsupported parameter: 'temperature' is not supported with this model. Confirmed by `lf probe`; on large request bodies this arrives as a dropped connection rather than an HTTP 400.
